about_the_game:
A Highly Interactive Role-Playing and Life Simulation Game

Dear Jungoer, welcome to JungoJam!

JungoJam now boasts a hip downtown strip, tranquil beaches, and islands perfect for unleashing your creativity. Here, you can be anyone you dream of! Team up with friends from across the globe to explore an interactive wonderland, design your Original Characters, and let the good times multiply with fellow enthusiasts!

  • Team up with fellow fans to design Original Characters! Thousands of avatar options to mix and match!

For lovers of original characters, this is your jam! Absolutely essential for bringing your unique characters to life! Freely customize body types, facial features, and outfits. You'll look as sweet as a cupcake, and trust us, you'll be totally hooked on our super adorable art style!

  • Dive into free-form Role-Play, with new experiences every day!

Let's play Cops and Robbers, or a game of Hide-and-Seek! Or why not try being a pet shop assistant, spending your day with adorable, heartwarming animals? Become a respected teacher, a life-saving doctor, a mysterious ninja, or even a mischievous ghost!

  • Build, Farm, Fish, and Pet Your Way Through Life

Build your cozy home, cultivate a garden, adopt an adorable pet, cast a line for some fishing, whip up tasty treats... Live your best slice-of-life adventure!

  • Epic World, Epic Adventures

From schools to hospitals, police stations to cozy cafes and bustling bars, this world brims with interactive details and surprises. Every soul you meet could spark a new adventure. Psst... watch out for the spine-tingling ghost hunt!

  • Infinite Fun with Friends

Squad up and throw the ultimate party in JungoJam—where happiness knows no bounds!

  • Island Tour: Create Your Own "Micro World" with One Tap!

Our super-smart AI Builder generates scenes instantly. Quickly craft your unique micro world with role-play features. Plus, visit your friends' islands for endless fun together!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (version 10.0.10240 or later) or Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-5800 or Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (6GB), RX 6500 XT, Intel ARC A380, or equivalent and above
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (version 10.0.10240 or later) or Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: i7-10700 or Ryzen 9 5900
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 SUPER, RX 6600, Intel ARC A750, or equivalent and above
